customers.name: Coopérative de l'Alibori
customers.quote: Rio warned us about water stress three days before the first leaves wilted. We irrigated in time.
customers.overview: Coopérative de l'Alibori is a 1,200-member agricultural cooperative in northern Benin, specializing in cotton and maize cultivation across 8,000 hectares. Faced with increasing climate volatility, the cooperative partnered with Gytev to deploy Rio.
customers.challenge: Farmers relied on generational knowledge and coarse weather forecasts. Water stress, pest outbreaks, and soil degradation were detected too late, leading to crop losses averaging 22% per season.
customers.solution: Gytev deployed Rio across 8,000 hectares using satellite imagery, soil sensors, and weather station data. The AI provides field-level water stress predictions 72 hours in advance, pest risk alerts, and optimized irrigation schedules via SMS.
customers.results: Within the first growing season, the cooperative reduced water waste by 34% and increased yield by 18%. Crop losses dropped from 22% to under 8%.

customers.name: National Blood Bank of Benin
customers.quote: RedQ gives us real-time visibility on every blood bag in the country. Shortages are predicted, not endured.
customers.overview: The National Blood Bank of Benin manages blood supply across 42 hospitals and 12 regional transfusion centers. Before RedQ, the system operated on reactive logistics. Gytev's platform transformed this into a predictive, data-driven operation.
customers.challenge: Blood product shelf life is limited. The blood bank had no real-time inventory visibility across its distributed network. Shortages of rare blood types were discovered only when patients needed them.
customers.solution: Gytev deployed RedQ as a centralized intelligence layer connecting all 42 hospital blood banks. The platform provides real-time inventory dashboards, demand forecasting, expiry alerts, and automated redistribution recommendations.
customers.results: Wastage from expired products dropped by 41%. Critical shortages of O-negative blood were reduced by 67%. Average fulfillment time dropped from 36 hours to 8 hours.

customers.name: Sèmè City
customers.quote: Quiisa keeps our 1,000-hectare development on track — every task, every team, every deadline visible in one place.
customers.overview: Sèmè City is Benin's flagship innovation hub and smart city project, a 1,000-hectare development zone near Cotonou. Gytev's Quiisa platform manages the complex multi-stakeholder construction and operations.
customers.challenge: Building a smart city from scratch requires coordinating hundreds of contractors, managing thousands of tasks across a decade-long timeline, and tracking budgets across multiple funding sources.
customers.solution: Gytev deployed Quiisa as the central project management platform. The AI prioritizes tasks, predicts delays before they happen, and automatically reassigns resources when dependencies shift.
customers.results: Project delivery speed improved by 28%. Budget overruns dropped from 15% to under 3%. The platform manages 2,400+ active tasks across 18 workstreams.

company.about: Gytev builds intelligent systems that understand the real world — systems that observe, understand, predict and act on farms, blood banks, cities and industries.
company.story: We started from a simple observation: the physical world remains fragmented, complex and difficult for software to understand. We set out to connect digital intelligence to reality.
company.vision: Our 20-year ambition is to build the intelligence layer for the real world. Data provides context, sensors provide perception, AI provides intelligence, software makes it useful.
